mentions.heading: Outstanding indebtedness and refinancing of fixed rate debt
mentions.detail: $5.54 billion debt: $3.00B Senior Notes, $2.19B Convertible Debt, $349M commercial paper; $2.25B revolver undrawn to 2030
mentions.quote: Changes in interest rates will have a more significant impact on our interest expense if we refinance our fixed rate debt with variable rate debt. There can be no assurance that we will be able to refinance our current or future debt on reasonable terms, if at all.

mentions.heading: Servicing our debt requires a significant amount of cash
mentions.risk_name: Insufficient cash flow for debt service
mentions.detail: Borrowings used to fund part of quarterly dividends in recent quarters; may cut dividends, buybacks or sell assets
mentions.quote: In several recent quarters, we have used borrowings to finance a portion of our quarterly dividend payments and we may continue to do so in future periods.

mentions.heading: Adverse changes in credit ratings could increase borrowing costs
mentions.detail: Investment grade maintained but downgraded by one rating agency in March 2025; affects Senior Notes and Commercial Paper
mentions.quote: While we have maintained our investment grade rating, in March 2025 we were downgraded by one rating agency and there is no assurance that we will maintain our current credit ratings.

mentions.heading: Conversion of Convertible Debt or Series A Preferred Stock will dilute stockholders
mentions.detail: 2017 Senior Convertible Debt principal settled in cash; Series A Preferred dividends payable in stock; may encourage short selling
mentions.quote: Following our irrevocable settlement election made on April 1, 2022 with respect to the 2017 Senior Convertible Debt, upon conversion, we are required to satisfy our conversion obligation with respect to such converted Convertible Debt by delivering cash equal to the principal amount of such converted Convertible Debt and cash and shares of common stock or any combination, at our option, with respect to any conversion value in excess thereof (i.e., the conversion spread).
